slides.headline: Tipaza Returned. Its Continuity Was Broken.
slides.subheadline: Trace an imperial hub’s transformation—and why its modern foundation means resettlement.
slides.svgBlueprint: Portrait SVG, viewBox 0 0 1080 1350. Paper background; 80px safe margins. Custom Brand masthead above orange kicker badge. Set headline at 72px across three deliberate lines; subheadline at 30px. Lower half: one monumental column silhouette in Ink, interrupted by a narrow orange fracture and displaced base. Two compact telemetry badges along bottom; issue badge beneath masthead. No diagrams, arrows, or callout boxes.

slides.headline: Destruction Was Not The Final Act
slides.subheadline: Vandal destruction interrupted the city; Byzantine reconquest did not secure its future.

items.title: Vandal destruction
items.body: Vandals destroyed Tipasa, but the invasion did not definitively end its prosperity.​

items.title: Byzantine reconquest
items.body: Byzantines reconquered the town; gradual decline followed from the 6th century.

slides.svgBlueprint: Portrait SVG, viewBox 0 0 1080 1350; retain brand palette and 80px margins. Headline 60px, subheadline 30px. Draw a thin Ink vertical spine at x180, visibly interrupted between two orange milestone nodes. Place two Surface panels to its right, each with a 52px date, 30px title, and 28px body. Behind the lower panel, architectural outlines become progressively incomplete. Sequence is top-to-bottom, not a proportional time scale.

slides.headline: The City Had Already Changed Identities
slides.subheadline: Before destruction, trade, conquest, and Christianity had repeatedly remade Tipasa’s purpose.

items.title: Commerce becomes conquest
items.body: Claudius turned a conquered Punic trading-post into a military colony for conquering Mauretania.

items.title: Imperial scale
items.body: Stéphane Gsell’s fourth-century population estimate describes the ancient city, not modern Tipaza.

items.title: Christian transformation
items.body: During late Roman governorship, Tipasa became an important Christian hub.

slides.svgBlueprint: Portrait SVG, viewBox 0 0 1080 1350; retain brand palette. Below a 60px headline and 30px subheadline, stack exactly three full-width ledger rows separated by orange hairlines. Each row pairs one minimal emblem—harbour, column, basilica—with its title and body. Embed the two quantitative badges within rows two and three; preserve their complete wording. Badge type 44px, body 28px. Faint offset foundations suggest successive uses, not uninterrupted occupation.

slides.headline: Surviving Ruins Are Not Continuous Settlement
slides.subheadline: Ancient destruction and modern foundation belong to different chapters, not uninterrupted urban life.

items.badge: the end of the seventh century
items.title: The ancient rupture
items.body: Umayyad forces demolished the city and reduced it to ruins.

items.title: The modern restart
items.body: Modern Tipaza’s foundation followed resettlement in the nineteenth century—not uninterrupted Roman urban survival.

slides.svgBlueprint: Portrait SVG, viewBox 0 0 1080 1350; retain brand palette and 80px margins. Headline 58px above two equal vertical panels separated by a 40px Paper gutter. Left: broken ancient foundations on Surface. Right: a distinct modern street outline on Paper. Never connect their baselines. Place the long historical date in stacked 30px text; set 1857 at 52px, never above 56px. Titles 30px; bodies 28px with manual wrapping. Orange edges face across the empty gutter.

slides.headline: Reinvention, Not Unbroken Survival
slides.subheadline: Modern Tipaza draws visitors to ancient remains; its identity survives through reinvention.

items.title: A new urban chapter
items.body: The modern town was founded anew; ancient ruins now anchor its tourism.

items.title: Heritage recognition
items.body: UNESCO inscribed Tipasa’s archaeological heritage—not a claim of uninterrupted urban survival.

slides.closingQuestion: What endures when a city’s identity outlives its continuity?
slides.svgBlueprint: Portrait SVG, viewBox 0 0 1080 1350; retain brand palette and 80px margins. Headline 64px, subheadline 30px. Make 1857 the full-width 84px hero numeral above its title and body. Below, place one compact Surface footnote card with a 48px 1982 badge. A minimal orange rectangular frame encloses disconnected architectural fragments, suggesting preservation rather than restored continuity. Set the closing question at 32px above the Custom Brand · tipaza.pub footer.
